rules.name: auth-reply-field-discarded
rules.description: a token/session verification call binds part of its reply to blank `_` — either the VERIFIED principal is discarded (callers then substitute a caller-controlled header/cookie value for the same role: the cache-hit account-swap shape) or the verification error is. Census rule: every hit needs the one-line triage question 'where does the value filling that role actually come from?'
